title: Slash story graph (story.json)
description: A single linear chain of sections. The story starts at `start` and each section links to the next via `next`; the reader descends the chain by scrolling. Every seam is an instant cut.

start.description: Scene id where the story begins.

scenes.description: All scenes in the story. Each entry points at a scene file.

id.description: Stable scene identifier, unique within the story.

path.description: Project-relative path to the scene file.

next.description: Scene id that follows when progress passes the end of this scene. null or omitted = story ends here.
